meta.title: Security — Everstead
meta.description: Everstead is built on bank-equivalent security standards. AES-256 encryption at rest, TLS 1.3 in transit, granular access controls, and a full audit trail.

hero.title: Your most sensitive information, protected without compromise.
hero.subtitle: Everstead was designed from the ground up for trust, privacy, and control. Every technical and operational decision reflects the responsibility we hold.
hero.trustLine: 🔒 AES-256 encryption  ·  🇬🇧 UK-based  ·  ICO registered  ·  No. 17166825

infrastructure.title: Built on SOC 2 certified infrastructure — top to bottom.
infrastructure.subtitle: Everstead does not operate its own data centres. Every layer of our stack is handled by providers that hold independent security certifications — so your data is protected at every point in the chain.

supabase.detail: All user data, documents, and account records are stored on Supabase's infrastructure, which holds SOC 2 Type II certification. Data is stored exclusively in the London (UK) region.

vercel.detail: The Everstead application is hosted on Vercel, which holds SOC 2 Type II certification. Static assets are served via a global CDN with EU-first routing.

stripe.detail: All payment processing is handled by Stripe, the highest-certified payment processor in the world. Everstead never stores card details — they go directly to Stripe.

resend.detail: Transactional emails (invitations, alerts, confirmations) are sent via Resend. Email content containing sensitive information is never stored beyond delivery.

pillars.title: Eight layers of protection for your plan.

items.title: AES-256 encryption at rest
items.desc: Every file, note, account record, and document you store is encrypted at rest using AES-256 — the standard used by banks and government agencies worldwide.

items.title: TLS 1.3 in transit
items.desc: All data travelling between your device and our servers is encrypted using TLS 1.3. Your information is never transmitted unprotected, including on public networks.

items.title: Role-based access control
items.desc: Permissions are granular and revocable. You assign exactly what each trusted person can see — financial accounts, legal documents, wishes — independently of one another.

items.title: Complete audit log
items.desc: Every login, file access, permission change, and update is recorded. You have full visibility into who has accessed your plan and when.

items.title: Emergency vault access
items.desc: You designate a single trusted person with emergency access. You control exactly what they can see and under what conditions access becomes active.

items.title: Automated backups
items.desc: Your plan is backed up automatically to multiple secure locations with point-in-time restore. No single point of failure. Your data is never at risk from a single incident.

items.title: Incident response
items.desc: A defined security incident response process is in place. In the unlikely event of a security concern, we notify affected users promptly and transparently.

items.title: Privacy first — always
items.desc: We do not sell, license, or share your personal information with third parties for advertising or any commercial purpose. Your data is yours. Export or delete it at any time.

gdpr.title: Your data stays in the UK. Full stop.
gdpr.p1: Everstead is operated by EVERSTEAD DIGITAL LTD (company number 17166825), a UK-registered company, and is compliant with UK GDPR. All personal data is stored and processed exclusively in London, United Kingdom. We never transfer your data outside the UK.
gdpr.p2: As a data controller, we are responsible for how your data is collected, stored, and used. You have the right to access, correct, export, and permanently delete your data at any time — directly from your dashboard or by contacting us.
points: Data processing follows UK GDPR requirements

demo.title: You control who sees what, always.
demo.p1: Permissions in Everstead are not binary. You don't have to give a trusted person full access to give them relevant access. Every person in your plan has a defined scope — and you can update or revoke it any time.
demo.p2: Share financial account references with your executor, funeral preferences with your children, and legal document access with your solicitor — all independently, all reversible.

release.title: Nothing unlocks on its own. A person decides, and a person verifies.
release.subtitle: The most important question families ask is how — and when — their plan opens to the people they trust. Here is exactly how it works. There is no silent timer and no automatic “inactivity” trigger.

steps.title: While you’re alive
steps.body: Your trusted people only ever see what you’ve granted them — and you can change or revoke it any time. Nothing is released without your say-so.

steps.title: A trusted person reports the passing
steps.body: Someone you’ve named notifies Everstead from their own access, with the death-certificate details. The report never unlocks anything by itself.

steps.title: We verify, then release
steps.body: Our team reviews and confirms the report — usually within two business days. Only then does the access you arranged open, and any sealed personal messages are delivered.

release.note: Every report, verification, and access change is recorded in your audit trail. Access only ever reflects what you decided — never more.

items.q: How is access released after I die?
items.a: There is no silent timer or automatic “inactivity” trigger. A trusted person you have named reports the passing from their own access and provides the death-certificate details. Our team then reviews and verifies the report — usually within two business days — and only then does the access you arranged open to your trusted people, with any sealed personal messages delivered. While you are alive, nothing is released without your say-so, and every step is recorded in your audit trail.

items.q: Can Everstead employees read my documents?
items.a: No. Documents are encrypted at rest using AES-256. Access to the storage layer requires service-role credentials which are restricted to automated systems only. No Everstead employee has routine access to your documents or personal data.
All data is stored in London, United Kingdom, on Supabase's infrastructure. We do not transfer your personal data outside the UK. This is compliant with UK GDPR.

items.q: What happens to my data if I cancel?
items.a: You can export your full plan at any time from your dashboard. If you cancel, your data is retained for 30 days to allow for re-activation, then permanently deleted from all systems. We do not retain backups of deleted accounts beyond 90 days.

items.q: What happens if Everstead is breached?
items.a: We have a defined incident response plan. In the event of a confirmed breach affecting personal data, we will notify affected users within 72 hours as required by UK GDPR. We will publish a full incident report including scope, timeline, and remediation steps.

Yes. Everstead is operated by EVERSTEAD DIGITAL LTD (company number 17166825), a UK-registered company, and complies with UK GDPR. We act as a data controller for your personal information. Our lawful basis for processing is contractual necessity and legitimate interest. You have full rights to access, rectification, erasure, and portability of your data.

items.q: Do you share data with third parties?
items.a: We share data only with the infrastructure providers listed on this page (Supabase, Vercel, Stripe, Resend), strictly for the purpose of operating the service. We never sell, license, or share personal data for advertising or marketing purposes.

Everstead is SOC 2 compliant. Every infrastructure provider we rely on — Supabase, Vercel, Stripe, and Resend — holds SOC 2 Type II certification, and our controls are built to the same standard. Certification documents are available on request.

cta.title: Have a security concern or question?
cta.body: If you believe you've found a security vulnerability or have a question about how we handle your data, please contact us directly. We take all reports seriously and respond within 48 hours.
